complexity_ledger.narrative:
CA-05 -- the disposition requirement. Full working: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/GOAL-consumption-obligatory/CA-05/refusal.md and .../harvest-recount.md; the rule itself is references/consumption.md.
WHAT SHIPPED. An epic may not close while a finding it filed is undisposed: D1 a disposition that is not `open`, D2 a note on a terminal disposition, D3 a named successor on a deferral. Vocabulary closed on purpose. NOT A GATE ON ANYONE'S CODE -- it reads one file in this repository and reports on this project's own epics; seven epics of static checking caught zero bugs and this epic adds none.
R1, DISCHARGED ON REAL INPUT. Run against the sealed 225-row ledger it REFUSES cut-the-apparatus at 10 of 15 rows open -- this epic, its own close-out, not a fixture -- while ACCEPTING falsifiable-instruments (30/30) and subtract-to-measure (30/30), and refusing ports-as-adapters on 2 of 28 rows under D2 alone. Two real epics pass, six refuse, the refusals differ in size and clause, and one real slice (--ticket CA-05) passes inside a refused epic. A rule that refuses everything is a constant, not a measurement -- the mirror of harvest class D1 -- so the discrimination was demonstrated separately rather than assumed.
THE FINDING, AND IT IS NOT THE ONE THE TICKET WAS SENT TO GET. The premise "consumption is 1 of 38 because nothing requires it" is half wrong. A disposition practice EXISTED, ran three consecutive epics, routed 83 findings into named successors -- including five purpose-built carry-forward issues, #144-#148, still open today -- and STOPPED DEAD on 2026-08-08 with no discussion in any record. And the same four epics are missing from SELF-IMPROVEMENT.md, whose sections end at SM-05 on 2026-08-07: the correlation is exact across all eight epics in both directions. Both registers lapsed at the same commit because nothing reported on either. CA-05-DF-01.
THE REGISTER. 38 verified before it was changed, then SV-01-DF-05's three unswept classes appended as G1-G3. Per denominator_rule: THE DENOMINATOR ROSE 38 -> 41, THE NUMERATOR DID NOT MOVE, 2.6% -> 2.4%; the rate fell on a bookkeeping repair, nothing regressed. 41 IS A FLOOR -- the sweep read 83 cards, the tree holds 95, twelve are unswept (CA-05-DF-04). And three of the four classes named by a ledger row are this project catching ITSELF committing the class; only A1 was consumed.
MEASURED ALTERNATIVES, REJECTED. (1) A pure-prose requirement with a grep, which the charter prefers -- rejected because grep cannot scope to an epic or check the D2/D3 grammar, and the "demonstrated refusal" R1 demands would not have been reproducible. (2) Hiding the instrument in tests/, where GOAL-apparatus-cut does not count it -- rejected as metric-dodging; it sits in scripts/ and is priced at +133 lines. (3) Retro-classifying `channel` on the 210 pre-existing rows -- rejected because assigning a channel from somebody else's prose is exactly the hand classification the field exists to end, and in bulk it would manufacture a clean history nobody measured. (4) Building the consumption half of the check -- rejected as apparatus measuring apparatus, and DECLARED as the instrument's known blindness instead (CA-05-DF-03): a row can satisfy all three clauses by being carried to an issue that closes unread, and falsifiable-instruments passes on exactly that shape.
PRICE. scripts/ 27,652 -> 27,785 (+133, scripts/disposition.py). tests/ +119. examples/validation/ 16,129, UNCHANGED. Card 6,281 bytes, sha256:2d7d4a0506d9b259, UNCHANGED -- clause (c) of GOAL-apparatus-cut holds. The surfaces are reported separately and never combined with the card.

ticket.objective: GOAL 02, IN THE OWNER'S WORDS: 'Detection, filing, scoring and re-scoring all work. Consumption is 1 of 38 because nothing requires it. Either a filed finding must receive a disposition before an epic can close, or the honest description is a measurement programme rather than a self-improvement loop. Both are respectable; the current state is neither.' THE OWNER CHOSE THE FIRST, WITH THE REGISTER REPAIRED. FOUR PARTS. (1) A DISPOSITION REQUIREMENT: every filed finding gets an explicit disposition -- consumed, deferred with a named successor, or wontfix with a reason -- before an epic can close. THIS IS A CLOSE-OUT REQUIREMENT ON THIS PROJECT'S OWN EPICS AND NOT A GATE ON ANYONE'S CODE; seven epics of static checking caught zero bugs and this epic adds no gate. (2) R1 APPLIED TO IT: ship it with a DEMONSTRATED REFUSAL on a real input -- run it against THIS epic's own filed findings and show it refusing a real close-out, not a fixture. This project has shipped three instruments later found blind. (3) REPAIR THE REGISTER: HARVEST-CL-03.md carries 38 classes and was untouched last epic, and SV-01-DF-05 filed three new classes into the ledger and not into the harvest, SO 38 STOPPED GROWING ON 2026-08-11 AND UNDERSTATES THE BACKLOG. State the TRUE denominator and, per denominator_rule, SAY WHETHER THE NUMERATOR ROSE OR THE DENOMINATOR FELL. Read the 1-of-38 honestly: THREE OF THE FOUR NEWLY-NAMED CLASSES ARE THIS PROJECT CATCHING ITSELF COMMITTING THE CLASS, not consuming it. (4) THE TWO MISSING FIELDS: a channel field on the ledger, asked for six epics ago and still hand-classified from free text every single time; and CL-04's cost block with basis and value at ticket close-out, proposed three epics ago and never built -- SV-05 measured 353,816 tokens at 0.57 findings per 100k, comparable to SV-01's 0.98 on the same basis, AND THAT IS THE FIRST TIME TWO ROUNDS IN THIS PROGRAMME WERE COMPARABLE AT ALL. Populate both from this epic's own tickets. RUN YOUR OWN RULE AGAINST THE SEALED RECORD BEFORE SHIPPING IT, per the charter -- SV-07 refuted its predecessor's recommendation in one command by trying to ship it. AND KEEP THE HONEST ALTERNATIVE ON THE TABLE: if the requirement cannot be made to work, saying 'this is a measurement programme, not a self-improvement loop' IS AN ACCEPTABLE AND VALUABLE OUTCOME.
